en.explanation:
Male population:
24000 x 55 / 100
= 13200

Female population:
24000 - 13200
= 10800

Male population after growth:
13200 x (100 + 25) / 100
= 16500

Female population after reduction:

10800 x ( 100 - 15 ) / 100
= 9180

Final population:

= 25680

Hence, final population = 25680
